title: The word “actually”
notes: P3.01 stays on the 03-D placeholder (the plan's 'a thousand plots multiplying' needs its own plate, not yet specified; a plain card is the plan's fallback).

Brick Pavements (USDA 1937) is brick-LAYING (a brick road being paved), not brick-making; shot 16 (329.24–357.40), men setting bricks along a kerb, is the closest to 'make bricks'. Labelled AMERICAN FOOTAGE · 1937. The film has a white film-edge strip down the right of the frame: crop it in Premiere.
MOI stills are ≈800 px: INSET only, never pushed past 1.05. 'Those take time too' is D25712 then D25714, XD between.

London Airport (1949): three pictures of a busy site under 'if everyone is already busy…': Wimpey lorries in convoy (shot 38 before an unlogged tilt at ≈273.5), a bulldozer over an earth pile (inside logged shot 31, ≈235–242), labourers on the new runway (shot 38 after the tilt, ≈276.5–280.3). Brackets set by grab strip.
Keynes tighter: the same Monk's House still held at 1.3× toward Keynes (the still is 1348 px; 1.3× of fit is still under native, so no softening).
QUOTE-KEYNES-2 is anchored to P3.09 ('Inside that limit…') and runs 8 s across P3.10 and past 236.63; QUOTE-KEYNES-2-LIT cuts in on P3.11 ('“Actually” is carrying…').

lines.json has P9.24 (the Part 9 repeat of 'Anything we can actually do we can afford.', scene 13) at 236.63–240.0 inside this scene. Almost certainly a lines.py mis-match on repeated text; nothing is anchored to it, but if retime.py maps P9.24 to its real place in scene 13 the time map here breaks. Fix lines.json (P3.10 should run to about 240) before phase 2.
Verb card VERB-1942-RULE-PLANT on 'That is the third thing you can do. You can plant it.' (5 s).

Ending: D24219 (bricklayers repairing a bombed terrace) then D24228 (workmen on a prefab's foundations), INSET, DIP to movement 3. The plan's Diary for Timothy bricklayer (≈17:00) was not found at 991–1130 s in the picture-only file; not used.
